import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Create imbalanced dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=500, n_features=5, n_informative=3,
                           weights=[0.9, 0.1], random_state=42)

# Check the class distribution before SMOTE
print("Class distribution BEFORE SMOTE:")
print(Counter(y))
print(f"Dataset shape: {X.shape}")

# Apply SMOTE to balance the classes
smote = SMOTE(random_state=42)
X_resampled, y_resampled = smote.fit_resample(X, y)

# Check the class distribution after SMOTE
print("\nClass distribution AFTER SMOTE:")
print(Counter(y_resampled))
print(f"Resampled shape: {X_resampled.shape}")

# Print the original and resampled shapes
print(f"\nOriginal: {X.shape}, Resampled: {X_resampled.shape}")
print(f"Minority class grew from {np.sum(y==1)} to {np.sum(y_resampled==1)} samples")
